export_model_caffe2_tracing: export a detectron2 model to caffe2 format using Caffe2Tracer and save protobuf files
export_model_torchscript_scripting: export a detectron2 model to torchscript format using scripting with instances and save
export_model_onnx_tracing: export a detectron2 model to onnx format using tracing adapter and torch.onnx.export
setup_cfg_merge: setup detectron2 config by merging a config file and command-line options then freeze
run_eval_exported_model: run evaluation on an exported model using COCOEvaluator and inference_on_dataset
